contract.author_recorded_subject: rpc: drain independent submissions through a bounded commit owner
contract.author_recorded_rationale:
rpc: drain independent submissions through a bounded commit owner

Keep ordinary per-request fee bounds, authoritative admission, snapshot publication and validation barriers. Only sendrawtransaction opts in; producer threads perform their existing callback waits and relay after commit acknowledgment. Drain immediately with no collection timer, share cs_main across bounded slices, and retain direct fallback under overload. Wallet, Chronik and existing fair P2P admission remain direct/separate.

Add callback/snapshot causal control, independent exception and shutdown/byte-pressure cases, plus native concurrent-error/conflict and sequential-array functional coverage. Candidate compile/runtime validation pending coordinated build; no performance claim.

Coordinator validated purpose integration (2026-10-21): includes original design46df, server-enabled lifetime fixupa422 and argv-only functional fixup4880. Retain full per-transaction authoritative admission/publication/callbacks; bounded immediate RPC-only commit owner, direct overload fallback, no P2P result flattening. Native-only functional enters with its real NativeMiniWallet/wallet-receive prerequisites. Typed outcome/barrier successor29736+d559 remains separate UNVALIDATED work and is excluded here.
contract.concrete_problem: Independent unlocked RPC producers repeatedly acquire the commit lock; one bounded owner can drain immediate slices while preserving per-request policy/results and notification ordering.
contract.split_mechanism: Standalone shared purpose; originaldesign46df+feature25a; a422serverlifecycle and4880argvfixups folded.
semantic_invariants: Full per-request authoritative admission/maxfee checks, per-transaction snapshot publication, validation callbacks and secondary wallet/Chronik waits preserved.
Only explicit unlocked sendrawtransaction opts in; P2P rich-result/fair queue and other internal callers unchanged.
Bounded256requests/32MiB immediate32-request slices; overload/stopped fallback preserves directauthoritativeverdicts. No collection timer/new userflag.
Node owns worker; HTTP drains before worker/dependencies teardown; serverOFF no worker.
validation_limits: Typed-owned outcome/shared callback barrier29736+d559 excluded; their new fixture gate failed before registration and remains separate successor.
rpc_independent_admission.py and wallet_v2_native_receive.py are created by global 517 (v2/143). They are required on native-wallet-receiving-20261020. This eCash boundary does not contain the files.
